description: Figure 5 presents a bar chart illustrating Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods from Static Experiments. The horizontal axis displays the source type, labeled as “Source Info,” “Most Basic,” and “Direct Command,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Entropy,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. Three bars are displayed, one for each source type. The “Source Info” bar is blue and extends to approximately 0.65. The “Most Basic” bar is orange and reaches a height of approximately 0.45. The “Direct Command” bar is green and extends to approximately 0.35. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are sorted alphabetically by source type.
